summary.en: Incyte combines late-stage hematology and immunology with expanding gastrointestinal oncology programs. ([Q3 update](https://incytecorp.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/incyte-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-provides))
summary.zh: Incyte将后期血液学和免疫学与不断扩展的胃肠道肿瘤项目相结合。([第三季度更新](https://incytecorp.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/incyte-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-provides))

ind.en: US filing for moderate-to-severe hidradenitis suppurativa; EU approved; also vitiligo and prurigo nodularis
ind.zh: 美国中重度化脓性汗腺炎申报;欧盟已获批;另有白癜风和结节性痒疹

ind.en: Newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ind.zh: 新诊断弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤
原发性血小板增多症;另有骨髓纤维化

next.zh: 二线骨髓纤维化III期启动

ind.en: First-line metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma; also colorectal cancer
ind.zh: 一线转移性胰腺导管腺癌;另有结直肠癌

next.en: Initiate Phase 3 DAWN-302 in previously treated colorectal cancer
next.zh: 启动既往接受过治疗的结直肠癌III期DAWN-302

ind.zh: 一线微卫星稳定型结直肠癌

ind.en: Platinum-resistant ovarian cancer; first-line maintenance planned
ind.zh: 铂耐药卵巢癌;计划开展一线维持治疗
CALR突变骨髓纤维化或原发性血小板增多症

next.en: Phase 1 data in CALR-mutated myelofibrosis and essential thrombocythemia
next.zh: CALR突变骨髓纤维化和原发性血小板增多症I期数据

watch.en: The Q3 presentation frames 2029 as the Jakafi transition and prioritizes growth beyond Jakafi.
watch.zh: 第三季度演示将2029年定位为Jakafi过渡期,并优先发展Jakafi以外的增长。

watch.en: Povorcitinib's prurigo nodularis Phase 3 data are expected in Q4 2026.
watch.zh: Povorcitinib结节性痒疹III期数据预计于2026年第四季度公布。

watch.en: September cash and marketable securities totaled $3.9 billion after the Vega acquisition.
watch.zh: 收购Vega后,9月现金及有价证券合计39亿美元。

watch.en: INCB123667 enrollment in Phase 3 platinum-resistant ovarian cancer was stopped as focus shifted to maintenance.
watch.zh: 随着重心转向维持治疗,INCB123667在III期铂耐药卵巢癌中的入组已停止。

sources: EU povorcitinib approval; US review continues, November 16, 2026
gaps: Origins remain unverified for INCB161734 and INCB123667. Additional unverified development codes remain null.
Company categories are proof of concept and pivotal rather than complete numerical phase totals; counts remains null.
INCB123667 retains its ongoing Phase 2 MAESTRA-1 status: enrollment in Phase 3 MAESTRA-2 was discontinued, while MAESTRA-3 initiation is planned for 2026Q4.
Povorcitinib received EU approval in November 2026; registration status here refers to its pending US filing, with potential approval and launch in 2027Q1.
The povorcitinib discovery release and 2025 annual report used for tafasitamab provenance predate June 2026. Current stages and milestones use October/November 2026 sources.
INCA33890 is also written INCA033890 in company material. Merus collaborations for INCA33890 and INCA035784 are identified in portfolio footnotes.
